selection.rationale: Unique maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the committed coarse monthly grid L{0,1,2,3,6,9,12} (775 valid combos, median OOS Sharpe 0.6818). Winner raw OOS Sharpe 1.3214 at L6 (signal chg_3m = T10Y3M 3-month change, T2_roll_p75 / P1_long_cash, procyclical); the 2nd-best valid combo (chg_6m/T2_roll_p50/P1_long_cash/L6) sits at 1.2178. No ECON-T3 tie-break engaged (unique max on oos_sharpe; raw codes equal the display codes, no alias). Published winner == raw max-OOS-Sharpe valid row -> divergence null.
